profile_model_flops: run get_flops_profile to measure the total FLOPs of a PyTorch model given input data
profile_model_flops_verbose: run get_flops_profile with verbose=True to print a detailed per-layer FLOPs breakdown
benchmark_model_compute: run get_flops_profile to benchmark the computational cost of a model on sample input
compare_model_efficiency: run get_flops_profile on multiple models to compare their FLOPs and choose the most efficient
review_get_flops_profile: review the get_flops_profile function to understand how FlopsProfiler is used for model profiling
